name: Dwarven Tinder
summary: Dwarven Tinder is a specially prepared flammable substance used by Alliance forces in the Wetlands. It was distributed to saboteurs tasked with incinerating the Dragonmaw clan's siege engines before they could be brought against Menethil Harbor.

sections.title: Sabotaging the Dragonmaw
sections.body: When Alliance scouts discovered that Chieftain Nek'rosh had constructed heavy catapults within the Dragonmaw encampment, Menethil Harbor faced an imminent crisis. Cut off from southern reinforcements by intense fighting in Dun Algaz, the defenders could not survive a prolonged siege. The solution was preemptive sabotage. Provided to volunteers advancing into orcish territory, Dwarven Tinder catches quickly from a struck spark, producing flames intense enough to consume reinforced wooden siege engines in minutes.

faq.q: What is Dwarven Tinder used for?
faq.answer: Dwarven Tinder is used to ignite and destroy the siege catapults built by the Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands, preventing an artillery assault on Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why burn the catapults instead of capturing them?
aliases: why not take the siege engines
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor's garrison is heavily outnumbered and cut off from Ironforge reinforcements due to the blockade at Dun Algaz. The defenders do not have the manpower to seize or recover heavy siege engines deep within hostile Dragonmaw territory, making destruction the only viable defense.

aliases: where does dwarven tinder come from
faq.answer: The tinder is supplied by the dwarven garrison stationed at Menethil Harbor, prepared specifically for quick, reliable ignition during military sabotage runs.

angles.text: Dwarven engineers and scouts know the value of dependable firestarters, particularly in the perpetually soggy, rain-drenched bogs of the Wetlands.
With the Dun Algaz passes contested, burning enemy war engines before they reach Menethil Harbor is essential to keeping the Alliance's primary marsh port standing.
